convert_dataset_cli: convert an image dataset folder or zip archive into a StyleGAN2-compatible dataset with optional resize and crop transforms
open_dataset: open an image dataset from a folder, zip, lmdb, cifar10, or mnist source and return an iterator over images
make_transform: create an image transform function that applies center-crop, center-crop-wide, or scale operations with configurable resize filters
open_dest: open a destination folder or zip archive for writing converted dataset images and metadata files
open_image_zip: open a zip archive containing images and iterate over them with optional label loading from dataset.json
